title: Read a ready Skill or Workflow
summary: Build use_skill from ready Skills and Workflows. Its enum and English description list that loaded set; calls return complete instructions or the Workflow guidance and stages.

replaceability.why: These four declarations are the Luc-agent protocol itself: every agent, Lumeri's own or a reviewed stand-in, reaches every Luc through them, and the protocol keeps them the same under a stand-in. A replacement would redefine the protocol rather than implement it, so only Lumeri changes them, together with docs/luc/agent-protocol.md.
replaceability.decided: Lead review 2026-10-23 under charter rule 6 (stricter class while unsure, pending Acrab); docs/luc/agent-protocol.md:40-43

operations.name: use_skill
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced. Input is the exact default shipped-set parameter schema, with enum order as tested by test_every_skill_reaches_the_agent_whole. The general loaded-set enum is dynamic (list(ready)), so this snapshot is not a universal input constraint. Draft: the format cannot bind that per-instance enum. Re-reading is naturally read-only but may now refuse changed package text; no model request is made.

invariants.text: Default ready Skills and Workflows reach the model whole and in English.

break: the operation raises unexpectedly or returns an answer outside its declared schema
failure.notes: No replacement seam or run-time interface validator exists for this role today; the class describes who may eventually replace it.

conformance.notes: Existing tests are evidence for the named invariants, not a replacement conformance runner. Only the area contract checker is run in this task.

known_deviations.text: A runtime Skill or Workflow fault becomes a refusal to the model rather than retrying unlayered instructions.
The input enum varies with loaded and ready Lucs. A fixed schema can pin the default set only, not every permitted local installation.

open_questions.text: Add a parameterized-declaration facility to the contract checker, instantiating use_skill.input.properties.skill.enum from the loaded ready names and testing at least the default and changed sets.
